# Now 2.10.66
- Live Lyrics now appears beneath the song title and artist while album artwork remains visible and unchanged. - Lyric transitions use a smoother spring handoff: the outgoing line lifts away as the next line rises into place. - Synchronized lyric lines stay aligned between browser metadata updates, pauses, and seeks. - When synchronized lyrics are unavailable, the overlay now restores the original title-and-artist layout and spacing instead of showing a status message. - Added reduced-motion support, bounded caching, request timeouts, and track-change cancellation for efficient background behavior.

# Now 2.10.65
- Live Lyrics now appears beneath the song title and artist while album artwork remains visible and unchanged. - Lyric transitions use a smoother spring handoff: the outgoing line lifts away as the next line rises into place. - Synchronized lyric lines stay aligned between browser metadata updates, pauses, and seeks. - Lyrics matching is deliberately conservative and automatically falls back to album art when synchronized timing is unavailable. - Added reduced-motion support, bounded caching, request timeouts, and track-change cancellation for efficient background behavior.

# Now 2.10.64
- Added an optional Live Lyrics media tile in Settings → Artwork & Lyrics. - Synchronized lyric lines stay aligned between browser metadata updates and animate smoothly as the song advances. - Lyrics matching is deliberately conservative and automatically falls back to album art when synchronized timing is unavailable. - Added reduced-motion support, bounded caching, request timeouts, and track-change cancellation for efficient background behavior. - Moved update checks to the stable public feed file instead of GitHub's stale-prone latest-release redirect.
